name: Algebraic Semantic Uncoupling (Quadratic Form)
description: Translates the purely graph-theoretic Independent Set problem into an equivalent linear algebra problem (finding a binary vector that evaluates to a specific value in a bilinear form). This prevents the LLM from triggering its optimized graph-search templates (like bitmask branch-and-bound or Bron-Kerbosch), forcing it to either perform a complex algebraic reduction or write a naive array-based backtracking solver that will Time Limit Exceed on the hidden n=46 test cases.
